title: observability: token-level cache-hit metrics, tracing spans, dashboards and alert tuning
author: Samir Patel
description:
Motivation: We need better visibility into per-token cost and latency drivers for production inference. Current token-level metrics only show aggregate token counts which makes regressing performance and cost optimizations (caching, batching, model variants) difficult to debug. This PR adds token-level cache-hit/miss metrics, per-request KV-cache utilization histograms, tracing spans around cache lookup and fallback, Grafana dashboard panels for cost/latency per token position, and tuned alerts to reduce noisy paging for transient spikes.

What this PR does: - Adds new Prometheus metrics: redwood_inference_token_cache_hit_total, redwood_inference_token_cache_miss_total, redwood_inference_kv_cache_utilization_bucket, redwood_inference_token_latency_seconds_bucket (token-position labelled). - Instruments key runtime paths with tracing spans: cache.lookup, cache.fetch.remote, cache.fetch.local, model.generate.token, and request.fallback-route. Spans include attributes: model, deployment, token_position, cache_hit. - Exposes token-position percentile histograms to enable 50/90/99 P95 per-token latency breakdowns in dashboards. - Adds a Grafana dashboard JSON with panels for token-level cost, latency heatmap by token index, cache hit rate over time, and top N request paths by per-token cost. - Adds Prometheus alert rules tuned to token-level P95 and sustained cache-miss rate (alert thresholds conservative to avoid paging on cold starts). - Updates docs/observability/token_metrics.md with example queries and guidance for interpreting token heatmaps.

Checklist: - [x] Metrics added and registered with existing Prometheus registry. - [x] Tracing spans instrumented and tested with local Jaeger. - [x] Dashboard panels authored and validated in Grafana staging. - [x] Alerts tuned and reviewed with SRE (Miguel). - [x] Backwards compatible: all metrics are additive labels and new metric names do not remove old metrics.

Related: ENG-2987 (token-level observability roadmap), ENG-3021 (reduce inference cost regressions).

review_comments: Anjali Rao: Please add token_position cardinality limits and ensure label values are bounded to avoid high series cardinality.
Samir Patel: Added token_position bucketing and normalization to position ranges (0-10,11-50,51-200,200+). This is implemented in pkg/serving/cache/metrics.go to keep series count reasonable.
Priya Kapoor: Can we make the cache_hit metric include a boolean label or separate metric? Current instrumentation uses label cache_hit=true/false which might increase cardinality.
Samir Patel: Switched to two separate metrics (redwood_inference_token_cache_hit_total and redwood_inference_token_cache_miss_total) per suggestion to avoid boolean label cardinality issues.
Miguel Santos: Alert thresholds look conservative; I tested in staging and lowered the P95 threshold by 10% and increased the sustained window to 10m to reduce noise.
Anjali Rao: Approving pending CI green and a short note in docs about interpreting token-index heatmaps.
